g.text: Customer Activity Analytics — Customer review use cases
Protected capability: authentication is a precondition,
not a decorative «include» repeated from every use case.
The assignment specifies an operator-facing application.
Customer is the business stakeholder and subject of review;
no direct customer interaction with this application is implied.
Business stakeholder/context only; not UI interaction
Conditional behaviour inserted under a stated condition
Specialized use case inherits common behaviour
Logical grouping inside the system boundary
